parameters.content:
## AI News Pipeline v002 — dual independent chains, shared static store.
Chain G (Guardian) and Chain M (MIT) share NOTHING except the static store.
A dead source kills only its own chain; the sibling stores + reports normally.
Schedule 30m present, workflow INACTIVE. No external sends except public RSS GETs. No credentials.
